steps: Soak the cracked wheat in cold water for two hours and rinse it.
Fry one onion in ghee, add the meat and brown it.
Add the tomatoes, baharat and pierced limes, cover with water and cook forty minutes.
Add the wheat, top up with water two fingers above and cook ninety minutes on a low heat, stirring.
Remove the bones, stir in the yoghurt and beat the porridge with a spoon or a mixer until creamy and uniform.
Fry the remaining onion dark brown and spoon it over the jareesh with its oil.
